subject: Decision Making
subcategory: Famous Decisions That Changed the World
title: The Brexit Referendum
description: A quick, practical guide to The Brexit Referendum.

hook.text: In 2016, David Cameron called a referendum on EU membership. He expected Remain to win easily. Leave won.

buildup.text: Cameron used the referendum to settle internal party disputes. The vote was a political tool, not a sincere question.

discovery.text: Leave campaigned with emotion. Remain campaigned with data. Emotion won. People voted with identity, not spreadsheets.

twist.text: Cameron resigned the next morning. He created an irreversible national decision to solve a temporary party problem.

climax.text: Brexit shows the danger of using irreversible tools for reversible problems. The tool was bigger than the issue.

punchline.text: Irreversible tool, reversible problem. The hammer was too big for the nail.

quiz.question: What decision mistake did Cameron make with the Brexit referendum?
options: He used an irreversible tool to solve a temporary political problem
